skill.description: Ask targeted questions about a codebase using its knowledge graph rather than guessing from filenames.

memory.responsibility: Retain developer question plus decisions, observations, and verification evidence needed to resume safely.

planning.responsibility: Transform existing code knowledge graph into the ordered, bounded stages defined by this skill.

action.responsibility: Advance the workflow through entity and path search while preserving stop conditions and user authority.

capability.responsibility: Expose only repository, runtime, and verification capabilities required by the bounded engineering task.

stages: Translate the question into graph entities
Traverse calls imports and data paths
Open the minimum supporting source excerpts
Compose an answer from graph evidence

maturity.claim_boundary: This repository validates and plans the harness contract; it does not claim live service execution or benchmark gains without a connected adapter and measured evidence.
